summary: 3D engine startup fix for the Windows EXE. Replaced esm.sh engine imports with jsDelivr/import-map loading.
notes: Fixes the Could not load the 3D engine startup error shown in v5.1.0.
Three.js and its loaders now use jsDelivr instead of esm.sh.
Keeps the Creator Hub, app updater and both GitHub jewellery packs.
No asset packs need to be redownloaded just because the Studio app updated.
